title: Finland – Medical education services – Psykososiaalisten menetelmäkoulutusten hankinta
description: Tuomi Logistiikka Oy pyytää Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen toimeksiannosta tarjouksia tilaajan henkilökunnalle tarjottavista psykososiaalisista menetelmäkoulutuskokonaisuuksista tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Hankintasopimuksen kohteena ovat Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen henkilöstölle järjestettävät psykiatristen häiriöiden psykososiaaliset menetelmäkoulutukset. Koulutukset toteutetaan ammattilaisten työtehtäviä tukevina lyhyt- tai pidempikestoisina koulutuskokonaisuuksina. Menetelmäkoulutusten sisältöön kuuluvat: - Menetelmän teoreettisten periaatteiden ja hoitomallin opetus - Menetelmän rakenteen, vaiheiden ja keskeisten työkalujen läpikäynti - Käytännön harjoitteet, case-esimerkit ja soveltamistavat - Luento-opiskeluun liittyvä koulutusmateriaali: Koulutusmateriaalit ja menetelmään liittyvä opetusmateriaali tulee olla pääosin suomenkielistä. Jos ei suomenkielistä materiaalia ole saatavilla, voi materiaali olla myös englanninkielistä Hankinta on jaettu osa-alueisiin seuraavasti: Osa-alue 1. DKT– Dialektinen käyttäytymisterapia Osa-alue 2. CBASP – Cognitive Behavior Analysis system of Psychotherapy Osa-alue 3. CRT – Cognitive Remediation Therapy Osa-alue 4. SCIT – Social Cognition and Interaction Training Osa-alue 5. START – The Short- Term Assesment of Risk and Treatability Osa-alue 6. KKT – Kognitiivinen käyttäytymisterapia -perusteet Osa-alue 7. Scema Therapy – Skeematerapia Osa-alue 8. MBT – Mentalisation Based Therapy Osa-alue 9. CBT-I, Cognitive Behavioural Therapy for Insomnia Osa-alue 10. HOT, hyväksymis- ja omistautumisterapia Osa-alue 11. BA – Käyttäytymisen aktivaatio Osa-alueiden 1-6 ja 9-11 koulutuskokonaisuudet koostuvat koulutuspäivistä. Osa-alueiden 7 ja 8 koulutuskokonaisuudet koostuvat koulutuspäivistä ja ryhmämuotoisesta työnohjauksesta. Lähikoulutukset ja -tapaamiset toteutetaan tilaajan hallinnoimissa tiloissa tai tilaajan osoittamissa tiloissa. Kaikki tarjouspyynnön mukaiset, soveltuvuusvaatimukset ja palvelua koskevat ehdottomat vähimmäisvaatimukset täyttävät tarjoajat valitaan palveluntuottajiksi. Palveluntuottajista muodostetaan sijajärjestys (=palveluntuottajarekisteri) kokonaistaloudellisesti edullisimman tarjouksen perusteella. Tarjousvertailu ja sijajärjestys muodostetaan osa-alueittain halvimman hinnan perusteella. Sopimuskausi alkaa 1.1.2027 ja on voimassa toistaiseksi. Hankinnan ennakoitu arvo on laskettu koko hankintakokonaisuuden osalta laskennallisen neljän (4) vuoden ajalta perustuen tilaajan arvioimiin asiakasmääriin. Hankintasopimuksen perusteella tehtävien tilausten määrät vaihtelevat tilaajan tarpeen mukaan, eikä hankintasopimus sisällä määrä- tai vähimmäisostovelvoitetta. Hankinnan kohde ja vähimmäisvaatimukset on kuvattu tarjouspyynnössä ja tarjouspyynnön liitteissä. Tarjoaja voi jättää tarjouksen yhteen tai useampaan osa-alueeseen. Rinnakkaisia tarjouksia ei hyväksytä.

title: Finland – Health and social work services – Tuetun asumisen palvelut
description: Tuomi Logistiikka Oy pyytää Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen toimeksiannosta tarjouksia tuetun asumisen palvelun hankinnasta. Tuettu asuminen on sosiaalihuoltolain (1301/2014) 21a§:n mukaista yksilökohtaista sosiaaliohjauksellista tukea henkilölle, joka erityisestä syystä tarvitsee hyvinvointialueen apua tai tukea itsenäiseen asumiseen tai siihen siirtymiseen. Tuetun asumisen palvelu on suunnattu täysi-ikäisille Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen järjestämisvelvollisuuden piiriin kuuluville asiakkaille. Tuetun asumisen palvelua voidaan myöntää henkilölle, joka erityisestä syystä tarvitsee apua tai tukea itsenäisessä asumisessa ja/tai itsenäisen asumisensa järjestämisessä. Tuki kohdistuu itsenäisen elämän mahdollistamiseen, osallistumisen vahvistamiseen ja turvalliseen arkeen, jossa asiakkaan omat valinnat ja itsemääräämisoikeus toteutuvat. Tuetun asumisen palvelu toteutetaan asiakkaan omassa kodissa tai Palveluntuottajan vuokraamassa asunnossa. Hankittava palvelu koostuu seuraavista tukijaksoista: - Tukijakso 1A: ohjaus- ja tukityöskentely enintään 60 tuntia enintään 6 kuukauden aikajaksolla. - Tukijakso 1B: ohjaus- ja tukityöskentely enintään 6 tuntia kuukaudessa enintään 12 kuukauden ajan. - Tukijakso 1C: ohjaus- ja tukityöskentely yksilöllisen päätöksen mukaisesti (noin 10-12 tuntia kuukaudessa). Hankinta on jaettu maantieteellisesti osa-alueisiin seuraavasti: 1. Tampere, Pirkkala 2. Kangasala, Orivesi, Kuhmoinen, Pälkäne 3. Ylöjärvi, Ikaalinen, Hämeenkyrö 4. Nokia, Sastamala, Punkalaidun 5. Lempäälä, Vesilahti, Valkeakoski, Akaa, Urjala 6. Virrat, Ruovesi, Parkano, Kihniö 7. Optio: Mänttä-Vilppula, Juupajoki Sopimuskausi alkaa 1.1.2027 ja on voimassa toistaiseksi. Hankinnan ennakoitu arvioitu arvo on noin 6 miljoonaa euroa vuodessa. Laskennallinen neljän vuoden hankinnan arvo on tällöin arviolta 24 milj. euroa. Hankintasopimuksen perusteella tehtävien tilausten määrät vaihtelevat tilaajan tarpeen mukaan, eikä hankintasopimus sisällä määrä- tai vähimmäisostovelvoitetta. Hankinnan kohde ja vähimmäisvaatimukset on kuvattu tarjouspyynnössä ja tarjouspyynnön liitteissä.

title: White Sands Intelligent Scheduling and Decision Optimization Management (WISDOM)
description: AMENDED 9/3/2026 REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) / NOTICE OF INTENT TO SOLE SOURCE White Sands Intelligent Scheduling and Decision Optimization Management (WISDOM) System Agency/Office: Army Contracting Command � Rock Island (ACC-RI), Rock Island Arsenal, IL 61299 Subject: Notice of Intent to Award a Sole-Source Task Order for White Sands Intelligent Scheduling and Decision Optimization Management (WISDOM) System Support NAICS Code: 513210 � Software Publishers (Small Business Size Standard: $47 million) PSC: AC32 � National Defense R&D Services; Defense-Related Activities; Applied Research Description: Army Contracting Command � Rock Island (ACC-RI), on behalf of the White Sands Test Center (WSTC) and Test Resource Management Center (TRMC), intends to award a sole-source task order under the Salesforce Enterprise Contract (EC) IDIQ, Contract No. W519TC26DA009, to Computable Insights LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of Salesforce, Inc., for professional services supporting the White Sands Intelligent Scheduling and Decision Optimization Management (WISDOM) system. The proposed task order will support discovery, architecture, and initial pilot/minimum viable product (MVP) activities for WISDOM, an AI-enabled enterprise scheduling and decision-support capability intended to modernize legacy scheduling processes at White Sands Missile Range. The effort includes support for scheduling workflow modernization, customer portal capability, conflict notification, reporting/dashboard functionality, and associated implementation planning. The proposed contract action will be awarded on a sole-source basis pursuant to FAR 6.302-1(a)(2)(iii)(A), Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements. Government market research determined that although multiple vendors provide general Salesforce implementation support, only Salesforce Professional Services, through the existing Salesforce EC IDIQ, possesses the OEM-level access, proprietary tools, internal engineering coordination, and platform authority necessary to perform the required discovery and architectural design effort without unacceptable performance, cost, or schedule risk. The Government�s market research further identified Computable Insights LLC / Salesforce as the acceptable source for this requirement. THIS NOTICE OF INTENT IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE PROPOSALS/QUOTES. However, all responsible sources who believe they can meet the full scope of this requirement may submit a capability statement, which shall be considered by the agency. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of market research. A determination by the Government not to compete this requirement based upon responses received as a result of this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Primary Point of Contact: Megan Haffey, Contract Specialist, megan.e.haffey.civ@army.mil, 520-692-9880 Secondary Point of Contact: Nicole Feddersen, Contracting Officer, corene.n.feddersen.civ@army.mil, 520-692-9813

title: High Throughput Four Laser Flow Cytometer
description: This is a sources sought notice. The purpose of this notice is to conduct market research and identify potential sources that can provide a ThermoFisher Scientific Attune NxT and CytKick Max autosampler that meets all technical specifications identified in this notice. NIST is seeking responses from all responsible sources, including large and small businesses. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this acquisition is 334516� Analytical Laboratory Instrument Manufacturing, with a Small Business Size Standard of 1,000 employees. This notice does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), Request for Quotation (RFQ), Invitation for Bids (IFB), or any commitment by the Government to issue a solicitation or award a contract. The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) will not pay for any information submitted in response to this notice. Submission of information is voluntary and will not result in any obligation on the part of the Government. NO SOLICITATION DOCUMENTS EXIST AT THIS TIME Requests for solicitation documents will not receive a response. Respondents shall clearly mark any proprietary or restricted information. In the absence of such markings, NIST will assume unlimited rights to all technical data submitted. BACKGROUND The Biosystems and Biomaterials Division (BBD), Material Measurement Laboratory, NIST performs high-dimensional measurements of engineered microbes to create and characterize biological sensing circuits and test AI-designed nucleic acid and protein sequences. NIST is expanding and upgrading its current Living Measurement Systems Foundry (LMSF) to double the LMSF's capacity by procuring "functional clones" of the existing automation system for microbial culture preparation, growth, and measurement and the existing high-throughput flow cytometry system for high-dimensional microbial measurements. A critical component of the Government's current need is that new systems and instruments operate with identical principles of operation, methods, and data analyses, to within manufacturing tolerances. High throughput flow cytometry is a critical tool supporting these measurements. The data measured by a flow cytometer is intrinsically dependent on multiple instrument design and operation parameters including sample flow path design; laser wavelength, power, and focusing; excitation and emission filter design and light-path placement; detector technology (photomultiplier tube/PMT, avalanche photodiode/APD, charge-coupled device/CCD), light-path placement and digital encoding; etc. Each parameter contributes a unique source of uncertainty in the resulting measurements derived from the measured data. LMSF's existing Attune flow cytometry system has been in use for approximately 10 years, over which time, its measurement uncertainties have become well understood. DESCRIPTION OF REQUIREMENT The Contractor shall provide one (1) Attune NXT Flow Cytometer that meets the following specifications, inclusive of shipping, installation, training, warranty, and extended service agreement for outyears: System Requirements: The instrument shall be configured with four excitation lasers: blue, red, violet and yellow. The instrument shall be configured with a CytKick Max autosampler for sampling from 96-well sample plates. Contractor shall provide a Windows-based control PC, with necessary hardware and software for controlling the flow cytometer. Contractor shall provide consumable fluids and calibrators/QC beads that are necessary for first-time system startup. Contractor shall provide an operations and maintenance manual covering proper operation, routine maintenance, and troubleshooting for the instrument and controlling software The manual may be supplied in hard copy or electronic format (or both). RESPONSE INSTRUCTIONS Interested parties shall submit a written capability statement addressing the following: 1. Company name, address, Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) number, CAGE code, and point-of-contact information 2. Business size and socio-economic status (if applicable) for the NAICS code provided 3. Description of company capabilities relevant to the products/services described above 4. Description of prior experience providing/performing similar products/services described above 5. Identification of applicable contract vehicles (e.g., GSA FSS, GWACs), including contract numbers 6. Any other information the Government should consider for market research purposes 7. State whether the proposed product is manufactured in the United States and if not, state the name of the country where the product is manufactured. SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS The information received in response to this notice will be reviewed and considered so that NIST may appropriately solicit for its requirements in the near future. All responses to this notice must be submitted via email to Sadaf.Afkhami@nist.gov, no later than 9:00 AM EST on September 9, 2026. Format: Microsoft Word or PDF Page Limit: 12 pages maximum Font: Times New Roman, 11-point Paper Size: 8.5 x 11 inches Margins: Minimum 1 inch on all sides

description: SOURCES SOUGHT / REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) White Sands Intelligent Scheduling and Decision Optimization Management (WISDOM) System PART 1: GENERAL INFORMATION Title: White Sands Intelligent Scheduling and Decision Optimization Management (WISDOM) System Contracting Office: Army Contracting Command � Rock Island (ACC-RI), 3055 Rodman Ave, Rock Island, IL 61299 Requiring Activities: White Sands Test Center (WSTC) and Test Resource Management Center (TRMC) Primary Place of Performance: White Sands Missile Range (WSMR), New Mexico Product Service Code (PSC): AC32 � National Defense R&D Services; Defense-Related Activities; Applied Research NAICS Code: 513210 � Software Publishers Primary Point of Contact: Megan Haffey, Contract Specialist; megan.e.haffey.civ@army.mil Secondary Point of Contact: Nicole Feddersen, Contracting Officer; corene.n.feddersen.civ@army.mil Response Due Date: September 9, 2026 @ 9:00am EST PART 2: DISCLAIMER This Sources Sought / Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for market research, information gathering, and acquisition planning purposes. This notice does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), Request for Quotation (RFQ), or Invitation for Bid (IFB), and it does not obligate the Government to issue a solicitation or award a contract. The Government does not intend to award a contract based on this notice and will not reimburse respondents for any costs associated with preparation or submission of a response. PART 3: PURPOSE Army Contracting Command � Rock Island (ACC-RI), on behalf of WSTC and TRMC, is conducting market research to assess industry capability, acquisition strategy options, and future competition pathways for the WISDOM system. The purpose of this RFI is to obtain industry feedback to refine the Government�s understanding of available commercial capabilities, improve the requirement, inform acquisition planning, identify small business participation opportunities, and assess transition and sustainment considerations for the contemplated effort. PART 4: BACKGROUND White Sands Missile Range currently relies on manual and legacy scheduling processes and siloed data sources to manage test events, range resources, and related coordination activities. The Government seeks to modernize these processes through the WISDOM system, an enterprise scheduling and decision-support capability intended to improve visibility, reduce conflicts, improve resource utilization, and support more efficient test planning and execution. PART 5: ANTICIPATED SCOPE The Government is assessing an effort that includes initial discovery, architecture, pilot, and MVP implementation activities for WISDOM. Based on current planning, relevant functional areas may include: Scheduling workflow modernization Resource management and allocation Commodities management Conflict detection and notification Authenticated customer portal capability Reporting and dashboard functionality Process/policy support functionality Agile sprint-based implementation support Architecture and implementation planning for follow-on enterprise scaling The Government anticipates that the initial effort may focus on discovery and MVP implementation, with potential future follow-on efforts for broader enterprise deployment, sustainment, support, advanced analytics, additional integrations, and localized implementation activities. PART 6: REQUESTED INDUSTRY FEEDBACK Interested vendors are requested to provide concise responses addressing the following: 1. Company Information Provide company name, CAGE Code, UEI, business size/status under NAICS 513210, point of contact information, and relevant contract vehicles. 2. Technical Capability Describe your firm�s relevant experience with enterprise scheduling, workflow/process automation, customer portal capabilities, resource management, reporting/dashboard solutions, and implementation in secure Government cloud environments. 3. Platform and Implementation Approach Describe your proposed technical approach, including any platform dependencies, required licenses, proprietary tools, integrations, or third-party support needed to deliver the contemplated capability. 4. Transition and Sustainment Describe the documentation, technical artifacts, and deliverables your firm can provide to support Government oversight, future sustainment, and potential transition to another provider. 5. Competition and Small Business Participation Identify which portions of the requirement are best suited for full and open competition, small business participation, subcontracting, or future phased competition. 6. Risks and Recommendations Identify key technical, schedule, integration, or sustainment risks and provide any recommendations regarding acquisition structure, phasing, or contract approach. PART 7: RESPONSE INSTRUCTIONS Responses shall be submitted in Microsoft Word or PDF format. Page Limit: Responses should not exceed eight (8) pages, excluding a cover page. Cover Page: Include, at a minimum: Company name CAGE Code UEI Business size status under NAICS 513210 Socioeconomic status, if applicable Point of contact name, title, phone number, and email Capability Statement Submission Method: Submit responses via email to: Megan Haffey, Contract Specialist; megan.e.haffey.civ@army.mil Nicole Feddersen, Contracting Officer; corene.n.feddersen.civ@army.mil Email Subject Line: �Response to RFI: WISDOM System � [Company Name]� PART 8: IMPORTANT NOTES This notice is for market research only. The Government may use responses to refine its requirement, acquisition strategy, contract structure, and future competition approach. The Government may or may not contact respondents for clarification. Responses will not be returned. Proprietary submission markings, if any, should be clearly identified by the respondent. Submission of a response is not a guarantee that a firm will be included in any future solicitation process. Thank you for your interest.

title: NATO Business Opportunity: M&S Paradigm Framework for Adaptive AI Simulation on Quantum (FAASQ)
description: Headquarters, Supreme Allied Commander Transformation (HQ SACT) Modelling & Simulation and Learning Technology (MSLT) branch is responsible for the development, direction, and coordination of Modelling and Simulation (M&S) support for strategic studies, experimentation, wargames, operational planning, exercises, innovation and capability development and for NATO Command Structure M&S capability development. Future M&S demands will exceed what incremental improvements to current simulation architectures can address. New mathematical formulations, computational paradigms and hybrid workflows are needed to tackle bottlenecks such as combinatorial search, uncertainty propagation and repeated scenario evaluation. Quantum computing has been identified as one of the key enablers of future NATO M&S development. The objective of this project is to support future M&S capability development by assessing the potential role of quantum technologies as disruptive, enabling, and/or transformational capabilities. The project will identify and test where quantum computing may provide operational, analytical, or computational advantages within future M&S ecosystems, and will derive implications for future NATO M&S capability requirements, technology investment priorities, experimentation activities, and long-term NATO M&S roadmaps. In lieu of a bidder�s conference, HQ SACT invites bidders to submit technical and contractual questions not later than 28 August 2026. Bids shall be received at HQ SACT, Purchasing and Contracting Office no later than 09 September 2026 at 9:00 am. No bids shall be accepted after this date and time. No hard copy proposals will be accepted. Please see attached for submission instructions. REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL Please see attached. BIDDING PROCEDURE A Declaration of Eligibility is NOT required for this opportunity. Do NOT submit your proposal to the Department of Commerce. Please submit your proposal directly to HQ SACT using the contact information provided in the RFP.

title: Bridge12 Technologies automated high-velocity microsecond freeze hyper-quenching system
description: Notice of Intent: Bridge12 Technologies automated high-velocity microsecond freeze hyper-quenching system. (75N98026Q01138) The National Institutes of Health (NIH) intends to award a Firm-Fixed-Price Purchase Order to Bridge12 Technologies under the authority of FAR 6.302-1, Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements. The National Institutes of Health (NIH), [Institute/Center], intends to solicit and negotiate on a sole-source basis with Bridge12 Technologies, Inc. for the acquisition of an automated high-velocity microsecond freeze hyper-quenching system for use with Q-band electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) research applications. The Government requires a rapid mix/freeze-quench system capable of achieving a dead time of less than or equal to 500 microseconds (? 0.5 milliseconds) and compatible with Q-band EPR applications. This rapid dead-time capability is a critical minimum technical requirement because the system will be used to capture and preserve short-lived chemical intermediates and transient reaction states that would not be adequately resolved using conventional millisecond-scale freeze-quench technology. Market Research Market research was conducted through review of commercial vendor catalogs, published product specifications, technical literature, and consultation with subject matter experts within the EPR instrumentation community. The market research identified Bio-Logic as another commercial manufacturer offering freeze-quench instrumentation. However, published Bio-Logic specifications indicate a minimum dead time of approximately 9 milliseconds. This performance is substantially slower than the Government's required maximum dead time of 500 microseconds (0.5 milliseconds) and therefore does not satisfy the Government's minimum technical requirement. No additional commercial sources were identified through the Government's market research that offer a microsecond rapid mix/freeze-quench system compatible with Q-band EPR applications and capable of achieving the required ?500-microsecond dead time. This notice is not a request for competitive quotations. However, any responsible source, including small business concerns (e.g., 8(a), HUBZone, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business, Veteran-Owned Small Business, Women-Owned Small Business, and Small Disadvantaged Business), that believes it can satisfy the Government's requirement may submit a capability statement demonstrating its ability to provide a product that meets the Government's minimum technical requirements. Capability statements must include sufficient documentation to establish the ability to furnish an equivalent system. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed acquisition based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Responses must be submitted via email to vensonm@mail.nih.gov no later than 9:00 a.m. EDT on September 09, 2026. It is anticipated that an award will be issued approximately five (5) days after the closing date of this notice, provided no acceptable capability statements are received.

Software as a Service (SaaS) - Case Management System - Office of the Federal Ombudsperson for Victims of Crime (OFOVC)
description: The Department of Justice Canada (JUS) has a requirement for a Software as a Service (SaaS) platform and associated services (via the issuance of Task Authorizations) to support case management of files enabling robust reporting and data analysis. This solution is required to effectively manage case files, increase capacity for trend analysis and support systemic reviews. The case management solution must be bilingual, respect Government of Canada accessibility and security requirements, be user friendly, have a data entry interface that will avoid the possibility of overwriting information from one victim/case to another, and have an efficient search engine. The system also needs to allow the deletion of transitory information in a victim/case file upon request from the user. The Office of the Federal Ombudsperson for Victims of Crime (OFOVC) need to acquire a new commercially-available case management system. This system should be a web-based service offered by the Contractor, where the data will be stored on a cloud (server must be located in Canada). The system should allow the OFOVC to capture, manage, and analyze information provided by clients/inquirers who contact the offices as well as facilitating the tracking of activities and follow-ups. JUS intends to award one (1) contract for this solution for five (5) years. There are security requirements associated with this requirement. For additional information, consult the solicitation documents.

title: Very Heavy-Lift Battery Operated Industrial Remotely Pilot Aerial Systems (RPAS)
description: The National Research Council of Canada's (NRC) Centre for Drone Innovation, part of the Drone and Flight Autonomy Laboratory, has a requirement for the supply of one (1) very heavy-lift, battery-operated industrial remotely piloted aircraft system (RPAS) for aerial vertical lifting and cargo transport, the FlyingBasket FB3 in the sling-payload configuration, including one (1) mobile beyond visual line of sight (BVLOS)-capable ground control station with quad-redundant datalink, battery sets and a smart charger, a remote-controlled load hook, dual video streams (forward- and downward-facing cameras), enhanced containment (4G and RF), a Starlink command-and-control capability, mission-management software and a documentation package including Specific Operations Risk Assessment (SORA) templates. The system will provide a runway-independent very heavy-lift aerial platform capable of carrying payloads of up to 100 kg, with a maximum take-off weight of approximately 175 kg, for the transport, deployment and testing of large, suspended and non-standard scientific research payloads including NRC's HySpex Mjolnir VS620 hyperspectral imaging system in remote, complex and operationally demanding environments. The requirement includes cargo pilot training and maintenance training, developed and delivered directly by the manufacturer, manufacturer-provided mission-planning and operational-authorization support, spare parts, technical support and a direct technical escalation channel to the manufacturer, with a minimum twenty-four (24) month warranty. Delivery of the complete system is required to NRC, Ottawa, Ontario, no later than March 31, 2027.

title: Ambient multi-metals monitoring system
description: Trade Agreement: Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA), the Canada–Chile Free Trade Agreement, the Canada–Colombia Free Trade Agreement, the Canada–Honduras Free Trade Agreement, the Canada–Korea Free Trade Agreement, the Canada–Panama Free Trade Agreement, the Canada-Peru Free Trade Agreement, the Comprehensive Economic Free Trade Agreement [CETA], the World Trade Organization – Agreement on Government Procurement [WTO-AGP], the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership [CPTPP] and the Canada-Ukraine Free Trade Agreement Tendering Procedures: to all pre-qualified suppliers Competitive Procurement Strategy: lowest price compliant Comprehensive Land Claim Agreement: No Nature of Requirements: Solicitation No. 5000096015 Environment and Climate Change Canada has a requirement for the supply of one (1) continuous ambient multi-metals monitoring system for field studies for delivery by 2027-03-31. The Contracting Authority for the Contract is: Megan Filliol Senior Manager – Procurement Operations megan.filliol@ec.gc.ca 819-307-2084 THIS REQUEST IS RESERVED FOR HOLDERS OF SUPPLY ARRANGEMENT # E60PV-19EQUI ONLY, FOR THE PURCHASE OF LABORATORY AND SCIENTIFIC EQUIPMENT, PARTS AND ACCESSORIES, SERVICES AND SUPPLIES. Only Suppliers currently pre-qualified on Supply Arrangement E60PV-19EQUI have been invited to bid. As a requirement of the Supply Arrangement, this notice is published on Government Electronic Tendering Service (GETS) for a period of 40 calendar days. The closing date published on this notice identifies how long the notice will be published. For the closing date of any solicitation under the supply arrangement, invited suppliers should refer to the solicitation documents. Suppliers that do not have a Supply Arrangement for the supply of Laboratory and Scientific Equipment, Parts and Accessories, Services and Supplies with Public Works and Government Services Canada, cannot submit a bid. Any bids received from suppliers not pre-qualified on the Supply Arrangement will not be evaluated. Suppliers may qualify under Supply Arrangement E60PV-19EQUI for Laboratory and Scientific Equipment, Parts and Accessories, Services and Supplies, at any time. Interested suppliers should download solicitation document E60PV-19EQUI/D from CanadaBuys (SAP Ariba) and submit a response as per the requirements of the Request for Supply Arrangement. The mandatory technical criteria are: 1. Must include a field-deployable continuous or near-real-time ambient multi-metals monitoring instrument suitable for unattended ambient air monitoring in a fixed monitoring station and adaptable to mobile or temporary field platform. 2. Must include automated particulate matter sampling and metals analysis in a single integrated system that has been validated by the US[MF1.1][AL1.2] EPA ETV program. 3. Must use non-destructive elemental analysis by EDXRF[MF2.1][AL2.2][MF2.3][AL2.4] or an equivalent direct metals analysis technology suitable for continuous ambient particulate matter monitoring. If an equivalent direct metals analysis technology is proposed, technical proof must be provided with the bid. 4. Must include PM2.5 and PM10 size-selective ambient sampling inlet options. 5. Must be able to measure and report ambient concentrations of all target elements required by ECCC, including Al, Si, P, S, Cl, K, Ca, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, As, Se, Br, Ag, Cd, In, Sn, Sb, Ba, Hg, Tl, Pb, Bi, and additional source-tracer elements relevant to ambient PM source apportionment. 6. Must demonstrate detection limits suitable for low-concentration ambient monitoring for health-relevant metals, including but not limited to Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, As, Se, Cd, Hg, Tl, and Pb, with minimum detection limit of <= 0.1 ng/m3 at user-selectable sampling intervals of 180 min or less. If a bidder proposes different integration times, the bidder must provide a technically[MF3.1][AL3.2] justified equivalent sensitivity comparison. 7. Must include software for instrument control, data acquisition, diagnostics, and reporting of metal concentrations and instrument status. 8. Must provide remote data access and/or remote polling capability. Remote system control is preferred and must be described if available. 9. Must include automated quality assurance features, including calibration stability checks, alarms, and status reporting. 10. Must provide standard data export through CSV or equivalent tabular data files and at least one digital communication interface such as Ethernet, TCP/IP, RS-232, Modbus, USB, or equivalent. 11. Must include all required accessories, calibration or verification materials, initial consumables, manuals, and start-up support required for operation. The responsive bidder already holding a Supply arrangement for Laboratory and Scientific Equipment, Parts and Accessories, Services and Supplies from Public Works and Government Services Canada who meets the mandatory technical criteria with the lowest aggregate price will be recommended for contract award.

description: Advance Procurement Notice Fire Hydrant Inspection, Testing and Maintenance (ITM) Garrison Petawawa, Ontario (with Security Requirements) Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform contractors of an upcoming contract opportunity at Garisson Petawawa, Ontario. The purpose of this APN is to allow contractors to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested contractors to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. Description of the Project and Services It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed from DND. Contract Number: 87918 Title: Fire Hydrant Inspection, Testing and Maintenance (ITM) Approximate Estimate: $750,000.00 Anticipated Posting: October 2026 Description: This service contract will include but not limited to: Scheduled Inspection, Testing, Maintenance and Minor Repair (ITM) of approximately 481 fire hydrants across Garrison Petawawa.  This includes flushing, flow testing, preventative maintenance, marking of hydrants and minor repairs.  The scope of the Contract does not extend past the hydrant connection valve into the municipal water system, nor does it include the replacement of the hydrant connection valve or the maintenance or management of the municipal water system. This contract is expected to be awarded to one (1) contractor for three (3) years with an option to add up to two (2) additional, two (2) year extensions. The estimated services are expected to cost $250,000 per year for a contract value of $750,000 with a possibility to extend up to a total amount of $1,750,000. Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements To be eligible for contract award, a bidder will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is Designated Organization Screening (DOS). Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing contractors early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, contractors that intend to submit a bid for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. title: AI-ENABLED TRANSLATION AND POST-EDITING SERVICES (MTPE MODEL)
description: The purpose of this Request for Information (RFI) is to seek information from industry on their ability to supply to CMHC modern and AI-enabled translation solutions, that support a transition to a scalable, efficient, and high-quality MTPE model aligned with Government of Canada requirements. The objectives of this RFI are to: • Identify available AI-enabled linguistic solutions (including NMT and LLM-based systems) • Assess functional, technical, and operational capabilities • Explore opportunities for workflow automation and integration • Understand cost structures and potential efficiencies • Identify risks, including security, data governance, and AI limitations • Gather industry insights and innovative approaches • Support the refinement of a future strategy to define an AI-driven translation model incorporating Machine Translation and Human Post-Editing (MTPE).

title: Size Exclusion Chromatography with Multi-Angle Light Scattering (SEC-MALS)
description: The United States Department of Agriculture (USDA), Agricultural Research Service (ARS), Southern Regional Research Center (SRRC) intends to issue a solicitation for the procurement of one (1) Size Exclusion Chromatography with Multi-Angle Light Scattering (SEC-MALS) detector instrument. This system will be utilized for the automated measurement of molecular weight and branching characteristics of scientific samples, such as polysaccharides. Delivery Destination USDA ARS Southern Regional Research Center (SRRC) 1100 Allen Toussaint Blvd New Orleans, LA 70124 Minimum Technical Requirements The required instrument must meet or exceed the following technical specifications: Application & Methodology: Designed for size exclusion chromatography with light scattering detection to measure molecular weight and branching characteristics for scientific samples (e.g., polysaccharides). Automation: Fully automated with respect to sample analysis (must include an autosampler) and data collection, requiring minimal manual user input beyond initial instrument setup and sample preparation. Components & Consumables: Must include all necessary components and consumables required for immediate operation, primarily including columns optimized for typical molecular weight measurements in size exclusion chromatography. Chromatography System: Equipped with all necessary pumps and temperature controllers required for high-performance liquid chromatography analyses. Detection Suite: Must feature an integrated or modular detector array including Refractive Index (RI), Viscometry, and Multi-Angle Light Scattering (MALS) detectors capable of performing precise molecular weight and branching quantification. Software & Interfacing: Includes all necessary software for data collection, advanced analysis, and data export, along with any associated user licenses and cables required to interface with standard IT hardware. Support & Training: Purchase must include professional installation, operational training for staff, and all necessary initial consumables for validation and startup. Warranty & Lifecycle Service: Includes a standard manufacturer warranty and/or service plan, with explicit options to procure future renewable and/or recurring service contracts for the operational life of the equipment. Submission Requirements for Interested Vendors This notice is for planning purposes only and does not constitute a formal Request for Quote (RFQ). Interested capabilities-ready vendors should submit a response containing the following information: Company Profile: Name of Company, Unique Entity ID (UEI), and Country of Origin for any proposed line items. Business Size: Identify company socio-economic status and business size (e.g., Small Business, 8(a), WOSB, HubZone, Large Business) relative to NAICS code 334516. Point of Contact: Company POC name, title, phone number, and email address. Technical Offer Overview: Brief description of the proposed equipment confirming it meets the minimum requirements. Delivery Schedule: Estimated delivery lead time to the New Orleans, LA destination from the date of contract award. Response Instructions Please submit capability statements and requested vendor information via email to angela.carey@usda.gov no later than the response date listed above. Please reference "ARS_1173071 SEC-MALS System" in the subject line.

title: Targeted Brain Stimulation
description: Notice of Intent to Sole Source Requirement This Notice of Intent to Sole Source is not a solicitation. This is not a request for quotes. The Department of Veterans Affairs intends to negotiate a sole source contract with Dartmouth Hitchcock Medical Center. Description: The Department of Veterans Affairs intends to negotiate a sole source contract with Dartmouth Hitchcock Medical Center to provide pre-clinical research support for a funded VA Merit Award. The requirement includes method optimization, performing experiments, data collection and analysis, manuscript preparation, scientific dissemination, behavioral and neural signature assessments, and evaluation of targeted brain stimulation outcomes. Dartmouth serves as the academic affiliate for the White River Junction VA Healthcare System and has an established collaborative research relationship with the VA for this project. The project relies on established scientific relationships and laboratory/core facilities at both WRJ VA and Dartmouth, including specialized laboratory resources, to support reproducible research and appropriate translation of research findings. Utilizing these established resources will save time, improve productivity, and reduce unnecessary Government spending. Based on these unique qualifications and the existing academic affiliation and research collaboration, it is the Government�s belief that Dartmouth Hitchcock Medical Center is uniquely qualified to perform the required services. Since the intent is to procure this requirement on a sole source basis, this notice of intent is not a request for competitive proposals. It is not a solicitation or request for offers and no solicitation will be posted to Contracting Opportunities on SAM.gov. The authority for this action is FAR 6.302-1, Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements. The NAICS is 541715. The size is 1,000 employees. The PSC/FSC is AN41. Any response to this notice must show clear and convincing evidence that competition would be advantageous to the Government. Responses must be received no later than the closing date on the announcement.

description: Notice of Intent to Sole Source Requirement This Notice of Intent to Sole Source is not a solicitation. This is not a request for quotes. The Department of Veterans Affairs intends to negotiate a sole source contract with: The Geneva Foundation. Description: The Department of Veterans Affairs intends to negotiate a sole source contract with The Geneva Foundation to provide technical research support for the funded VA Merit Award. The requirement supports ongoing collaborative pre-clinical research at the White River Junction VA Healthcare System and includes method optimization, experimental planning, troubleshooting, technical support, model refinement, data analyses and interpretation, quarterly scientific team meetings, and manuscript preparation and scientific dissemination. The Geneva Foundation is uniquely qualified to provide these services because of its established scientific collaboration with the VA on this ongoing research and the specialized expertise and knowledge of the project protocols, experimental models, and scientific objectives required to maintain continuity of the VA-funded study. title: Integrated Commercial Vetting and Data-Analysis Pilot Services for USCIS
description: The purpose of this Amendment 0001 is to extend the deadline for responses to this combined synopsis/solicitation to 10 AM ET Wednesday, September 9, 2026 and provide clarification to this combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) 12.202(b)(1). i. This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with RFO 12. This announcement (under original posting from August 27, 2026, in conjunction with this Amendment 0001) constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 70SBUR26R00000015 is issued as a request for proposal (RFP) for Integrated Commercial Vetting and Data-Analysis Pilot Services. This acquisition is not set aside for small business concerns. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov. ii. A list of line-item number(s) and items, quantities, and units of measure. Contract Line-Item Number (CLIN): 0001 Description: Integrated Commercial Vetting and Data-Analysis Pilot Services Quantity: One (1) Unit Identifier: Lot (LO) Period of Performance: September 15, 2026, to October 14, 2026 (Anticipated) Place of Performance: Contractor Owned Facility Product Service Code: B506 � Data Analysis (Other Than Scientific) iii. Description of requirements for the items to be acquired, including documentation supporting any brand name descriptions (see 12.102). USCIS requires timely, scalable, and intelligence-driven capabilities to support the identification of potential fraud indicators and enhanced vetting activities involving individuals throughout the USCIS immigration lifecycle. The required capability must support batch processing of Government-provided target records; identity resolution and corroboration using authoritative commercial and publicly available information; identification and correlation of publicly available online identities and digital activity associated with target records; application of USCIS-designated review criteria; and source documentation sufficient for analyst validation and Government review. The requirement also includes qualified analyst and data scientist support to validate results, reduce duplicative or irrelevant information, refine workflows, and assess pilot performance. title: IRadimed Research Equipment
description: Notice of Intent to Sole Source Requirement This Notice of Intent to Sole Source is not a solicitation. This is not a request for quotes. The Department of Veterans Affairs intends to negotiate a sole source contract with IRADIMED Corporation. Description: The Department of Veterans Affairs intends to negotiate a sole source contract with IRADIMED Corporation for an MRI-compatible physiological monitoring system and accessories for the VA Boston Healthcare System / Translational Research Center for TBI and Stress Disorders (TRACTS). The requirement includes an MRI Standard Monitor System with ecQ-TEK (ECG, SpO2, NIBP, and CO2), an MRI Monitor Remote System with tablet, base and recorder, an IRADIMED roll stand, a flexible mounting adapter, two-day training for TRACTS staff, and two one-year Premium Maintenance Agreements. The IRADIMED 3880 provides continuous monitoring of blood pressure, heart rate and rhythm (ECG), blood oxygenation (SpO2), respiration, and end-tidal CO2 during MRI procedures. These capabilities are critical for participant safety and physiological data collection during studies involving controlled respiratory gas challenges. Therefore, it is the Government's belief that IRADIMED Corporation is the only responsible source capable of meeting this requirement. Since the intent is to procure this requirement on a sole source basis, this notice of intent is not a request for competitive proposals. It is not a solicitation or request for offers and no solicitation will be posted to Contracting Opportunities on SAM.gov. The authority for this action is FAR 6.302-1, Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements. The NAICS is 339112. The size standard is 1,000 employees. The PSC/FSC is AJ11. Any response to this notice must show clear and convincing evidence that competition would be advantageous to the Government. Responses must be received by the date and time specified in the SAM.gov notice. No telephonic inquiries will be accepted. All responses must be submitted to the Contracting Officer identified in the SAM.gov notice.

description: This sources sought notice is for market research and planning purposes only. It is not a request for proposals, quotes, or bids and does not commit the Government to award a contract. Overview of Scope: The MRC MOD1 Lab Waste Pre-Treatment System Replacement project involves the comprehensive replacement of laboratory waste treatment systems within four treatment rooms throughout the FDA's Muirkirk Road Complex in Laurel, MD. The primary objective is to replace the outdated lab waste pretreatment components that have reached the end of their effective service life, enhanced overall laboratory waste management capabilities while ensuring compliance with current environmental regulations. The project scope involves removal of existing equipment and installation of new hardware and software components across multiple treatment rooms (G103, G701B, Loading Dock Waste Room, and G305). Additionally, the project requires careful coordination with FDA and GSA stakeholders to ensure proper system integration and minimal disruption to ongoing facility operations.

Die Steuerung erfolgt über ein zentrales Automatisierungssystem mit Anbindung an die übergeordnete Leittechnik, Not-Aus- und Erdungsautomatik. BSV 670 V DC (Bordspannungsversorgungsanlagen / Depoteinspeisung) Die BSV stellt die 670 V-Gleichstromversorgung für abgestellte Fahrzeuge bereit und versorgt das Bordnetz der Züge während Wartungs- und Abstellzeiten. Die Anlage umfasst Transformatoren, Gleichrichter, Niederspannungshauptverteilungen, Steuerungstechnik sowie die zugehörigen Einspeise- und Entnahmeeinrichtungen. Die Ausführung erfolgt gemäß den Anforderungen von DB Fernverkehr und Siemens für moderne ICE-Fahrzeuge. K1-3 Integration BSV u. EZVA Die zentrale Energie- und Steuerungstechnik wird im Technikbereich K3 installiert. Von dort werden die Leistungs- und Steuerkabel zu den Entnahmestellen in K1 geführt. Die Integration umfasst die komplette Kabelinfrastruktur, Brandschutzabschottungen zwischen K3 und K1, Erdungs- und Potentialausgleichssysteme sowie die Anbindung an die übergeordnete Leittechnik, die Abschalt- und Erdungsautomatik und weitere Gewerke.

BACKGROUND The Division of Population Health Research (DiPHR) within the Eunice Kennedy Shriver National Institute of Child Health and Human Development, requires automated collection and management of large-scale public social media data related to food, nutrition, eating behaviors, hunger, and sentiment from platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, and X (Twitter). Access to these services will accelerate research productivity and generate preliminary data for future external funding opportunities. SALIENT CHARACTERISTICS The DiPHR has utilized Apify in the past, and is seeking information on this and other comparable solutions available commercially. The solution must provide scalable data acquisition capabilities that enable efficient collection of millions of text, image, and video records needed for artificial intelligence (AI), Large Language Models (LLMs), computer vision, and machine learning analyses. Data acquisition must be timely, reproducible, and conducted on a large-scale. Additionally, the solution must: Collect public social media data from multiple platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, and X (Twitter), to support research on food, nutrition, eating behaviors, hunger, and public sentiment. Feature automated, scalable data extraction capable of collecting millions of text, image, video, engagement, and metadata records to meet study data collection needs. Facilitate structured data export and storage capabilities (e.g., JSON, CSV) to support efficient data management, reproducibility, and integration with research workflows. Possess scheduling and automation features that enable continuous or periodic data collection to support longitudinal monitoring and trend analyses. Incorporate data quality controls, including filtering, deduplication, and validation features, to improve data accuracy and reliability. Allow for API access and compatibility with artificial intelligence (AI), natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, machine learning, and Large Language Model (LLM) workflows to support advanced analyses. Maintain secure cloud-based infrastructure and data management capabilities to support compliant and efficient research operations. REQUESTED INFORMATION The Government requests feedback from interested parties regarding potential sources for solutions meeting the requirements in this notice. Interested parties submitting a response are asked to include the following information: Organization name, including any "DBA" if applicable. Universal Entity Identifier (UEI) Business size and socioeconomic category Capabilities statement for the organization Technical capabilities of the solution A rough order of magnitude (ROM) or a commercial price list which can be utilized to determine estimated pricing for 12-months of services.
